name: THINH HOANG
typed: shipping AI sales agents on Messenger & Zalo
orchestrating an AI dev team with Claude Code
intro: I build AI agents that work in production: sales agents that answer customers on Messenger, Zalo and Facebook Page comments, recognize products from customer photos, take orders in Vietnamese and know when to hand off to a human. Around them I build the platform pieces: OpenClaw plugins and skills, schema-driven dashboards, webhook services that survive multiple replicas, and E2E suites that test like a real user. That code is private, so this page shows what it taught me instead. Every number here comes from real data.

notes.title: The silent agent looks exactly like a broken one
notes.symptom: Customers got no reply and every dashboard said healthy.
notes.cause: The runtime drops a deliberate 'no reply' before delivery; even the skip hook never sees it. Only the transcript knew.
notes.fix: Detect silent turns from the transcript and alert on them.

notes.title: 'AI found 0 products' was really a 400
notes.symptom: Product recognition returned an empty list on every photo.
notes.cause: The gateway only accepts temperature = 1; the host caught the error and mapped it to [].
notes.fix: Never turn an exception into an empty result. Surface provider errors.

notes.title: One photo, two copies, zero memory
notes.symptom: The agent described a customer photo it could no longer see.
notes.cause: The image was attached twice at full size, context overflowed, compaction dropped it.
notes.fix: One downscaled copy, and 'I can't see it' is a valid answer.

notes.title: 'Take 2, no bag' is an order, not a refusal
notes.symptom: Real orders were blocked as cancellations.
notes.cause: Negation vetoed the whole sentence; unaccented 'dung roi' is both 'right' and 'don't'.
notes.fix: Windowed negation around commit verbs, affirmations first. 34/34 + 49/49 cases.

notes.title: 429 HTML is not 401 JSON
notes.symptom: A valid bot token looked revoked.
notes.cause: An IP-level rate limit answers in HTML; a revoked token answers JSON 401 instantly. Poll without backoff and you cause the 429 yourself.
notes.fix: Classify by status and content type, back off exponentially.

notes.title: The runtime edits your system prompt
notes.symptom: The persona told users the wrong model name.
notes.cause: The agent runtime appends 'if asked which model, answer X' after your prompt, and last instruction wins.
notes.fix: State precedence explicitly in the persona, then A/B it.

film.title: Bàn tay mười nghìn
film.facts: 11:47 · original story · 109 lines in 11 chapters · 5 character voices · ~20 hand-drawn sets · 1080p30
film.pipeline: Script → Gemini TTS, 3 takes per line → Whisper large-v3-turbo keeps the take that matches the script → mouth envelopes and cue timing → every frame redrawn by a canvas ink rig → HyperFrames render. No drawing app, no timeline.
